body: --all no longer bundles shank_go_server (was silently launching a live game server); RunStart now returns 1 on any child failure; observation-watcher pgrep pattern tightened to avoid matching tail -f of its own log; entity-graph/eps-reconciler/eps-processor gained proper emily start integration with pgrep idempotency. Commit 2b33360. Found during pre-reboot hardening audit.
title: emily start: fix --all/shankpit gating, silent exit-0 on failure, pgrep over-match; add entity-graph/eps-reconciler/eps-processor coverage
